title: Assessment of Asymptomatic Heart Disease in Children With HIV
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to perform cardiac evaluation in HIV-1 (predominantly clade C)infected children by history, physical examination, echocardiogram and plasma N-terminal pro-B-type natriuretic peptide (N-BNP)measurement in order to determine asymptomatic abnormalities.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infants and children congenitally infected with HIV-1
